defects.title: Null OHLCV grid rows stamped with a later cleaning release id
defects.layer: CLEANING -> CACHE (imported into the R06 candidate view)
defects.exact_counterexample: STOCK_DAILY_RAW_PIT_R1/year=2026/part_2026.parquet row (2026-01-05, 000005.XSHE) has open/high/low/close/volume/money all null while source_version='BLACKBOX_FORMAL_CLEANING_R45_DAILY_TIP_ASOF_20260924_20260925_034534'

family_a.proof: first valued date == SECURITY_MASTER start_date, e.g. 603468.XSHG start 2026-08-06 / first valued 2026-08-06

family_b.proof: code absent from SECURITY_MASTER_SNAPSHOT_R1, zero 2025 rows, exactly 105 null rows each ending 2026-06-12

defects.consumer_impact: r07_rebuild_local.recompute() aborts on PRICE_INPUT_NULL; any factor recompute over the stored prefix aborts
defects.source_reference: reviews/R07/r07_rebuild_local.py:48 (check at :26); row stamp field source_version
defects.safe_local_action: NONE (blocked); do not filter, do not drop rows, do not re-download

defects.title: Stale competing calendars inside the authority directory
defects.exact_counterexample: CALENDAR_ALL_DATES.parquet reports 2026-08-31/2026-09-01 as non-sessions while the asof-versioned calendar reports both as sessions

measured.selection_hazard: a naive glob sorted by path returns the bare stale file last ('CALENDAR_TRADE_DAYS.parquet' > 'calendar_cn_exchange_v2_asof_...'), so 'latest' selection can land on stale data

defects.consumer_impact: false NON_SESSION classification and false date-set mismatch

defects.title: Diagnoser enum is disjoint from the pinned HAND enum
defects.exact_counterexample: the diagnoser's allowed_root_causes contains no SOURCE_MISSING, RAW_COMPLETE_CLEANING_MISSING, CLEANING_COMPLETE_CACHE_MISSING, READER_LOAD_MISSING, FILTER_EMPTY, CACHE_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE, etc.; only UNKNOWN_STOP overlaps
defects.consumer_impact: the tool cannot emit any classification the gate rule accepts

defects.title: Coverage-common module is an empty file
defects.consumer_impact: every --dataset STOCK_DAILY diagnosis returns STOCK_DAILY_CLASSIFIER_UNAVAILABLE with authority_ready=false
defects.source_reference: scripts import at line 46; failure at the import, captured verbatim in LAYER_SEARCH_AND_BINDING_LEDGER.json#L14

defects.title: Cache coverage non-regression gate is an empty file
defects.consumer_impact: FULL_HISTORY_NON_REGRESSION and on_lost_dates=PUBLISH_ALLOWED=false are declared but not mechanically enforceable; a release with lost sessions can still be published

defects.title: Coverage ledger scope cannot certify the requested dates
defects.exact_counterexample: BLACKBOX_RAW_COVERAGE_LEDGER_CURRENT.json declares STOCK_DAILY window 2026-06-01..2026-08-11 and was generated 2026-08-12
defects.consumer_impact: ledger silence is easily misread as absence

defects.title: FUND-like view silently degrades to ETF-only
defects.exact_counterexample: FUND_LIKE_ASSET_VIEW_R1/VIEW.json unions ETF_DAILY_PIT_R1 and FUND_DAILY_PIT_R1; FUND_DAILY_PIT_R1 contains zero files
defects.consumer_impact: fund queries return ETF-only rows with no error; 'no fund rows' is then misreported as missing fund data

defects.title: ETF cache is a 39-session slice while RAW holds full history
defects.exact_counterexample: ETF_DAILY_PIT_R1 date window starts 2026-07-30 and contains 39 distinct sessions; RAW fund_etf_price_daily holds annual files 2014..2026
defects.consumer_impact: violates PATCH_CANNOT_SERVE_AS_FULL / FULL_HISTORY_NON_REGRESSION in spirit; ETF consumers see a 2-month plane

defects.title: Index daily 2026 H1 hole with an available minute-plane alternative
defects.exact_counterexample: INDEX_DAILY_R1 has 137 consecutive missing sessions 2026-01-05..2026-07-29; P3_index_minute 1m files cover 178 2026 sessions 2026-01-05..2026-09-24
defects.consumer_impact: index consumers see no 2026 H1 daily bars although minute data exists

defects.title: Universe plane ends two months before asof
defects.exact_counterexample: MARKET_UNIVERSE_PIT_R1 max date 2026-07-20 against release asof 2026-09-24
defects.consumer_impact: downstream joins on recovered dates can yield UNIVERSE_EMPTY, which then looks like missing data

defects.title: Valuation product exposes 48 dates across a 2003-session window
defects.exact_counterexample: VALUATION_PIT_R1 SOURCE_FULL.parquet earliest date 2018-06-28; product holds 48 distinct dates against 2003 sessions
defects.consumer_impact: valuation joins silently return sparse rows

defects.title: Time-column naming and encoding drift across layers
defects.exact_counterexample: RAW adjust_factor unit adjust_factor__incremental_20260831__20260831_163108.parquet has column `date` whose values are 0..5211 (an ordinal), not calendar dates; RAW price uses `time`; cache uses `date`; FUND_NAV uses `day`; VALUATION carries both `date` and `signal_date`
defects.consumer_impact: a filter on date == '2026-08-31' against that RAW unit returns zero rows, producing a false absence; date-derived calendar inference from ADJUST_FACTOR is also unsafe
